headline: 8 Michigan deals, $250K raised — led by Esperion Therapeutics, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) reported completing an acquisition or disposition of assets involving Corstasis Therapeutics Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$180M.
O2 Drilling Holdings, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based fund, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $31M of equity and pooled fund interests issued to 7 investors.
NWA Equity, LLC, a Farmington-based real estate company, filed a $250K equity offering under Rule 506(b); $250K sold to 1 investor.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $250K sold across 2 Form D filings this week, down 100% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was NWA Equity, LLC (Farmington, Other Real Estate) targeting $250K. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) closed a transaction with Corstasis Therapeutics Inc.. It was one of 4 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $31M raised so far — led by O2 Drilling Holdings, LLC (Business Combination (Form D)). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
